data.name: Juhiyaa
data.gender_notes: Juhiyaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Juhiyaa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Juhi', meaning 'to bloom' or 'to grow'. This name symbolizes the youthful and vibrant energy of new beginnings and growth. The name Juhiyaa carries the meaning “Blooming, Youthful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Juhiyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming, youthful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_sanskrit.name: जुहीया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Juhiyaa is derived from the Sanskrit word जुही (juhi), which means 'to shine', 'to radiate', or 'to illuminate'. The suffix -या (-yaa) is added to the root to denote femininity. Thus, Juhiyaa can be interpreted as a 'Radiant' or 'Shining' woman.

in_hindi.name: जूहीया
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Juhiyaa in Hindi is derived from the Hindi words जूढ़ी (juđhī), which means 'plump', 'full-figured', or 'voluptuous', and या (yā), which is a feminine suffix. Therefore, Juhiyaa can be interpreted as a 'Plump' or 'Full-figured' woman.
